description: NAV per GBLIN share over time, read from the chain at past blocks, beside the ETH/USD and BTC/USD oracle prices the vault itself uses, with the change of each over the window and the NAV's largest drawdown. History starts at the deployment of the vault in service. Use it to judge how the index behaved against holding ETH or BTC over the same span.

interval.description: Spacing of the points. Default day.

points.description: How many points, newest last. Default 30.

name: treasury.nav_history

series.description: Oldest first: time, block, NAV in ETH and USD, ETH/USD and BTC/USD.

summary.description: Change of NAV, ETH and BTC over the window, and the NAV's largest drawdown.
